verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Dagster+ alerts can notify users of critical deployment events, and alert policies can target capacity metrics. That is an event-subscription mechanism, but nothing in the pack says webhooks are a delivery channel. Sensors react to events but are inbound triggers, not outbound subscriptions. Missing for 10: documented webhook delivery of events, payload/schema docs for webhook events, webhook support in OSS (alerts are Dagster+ only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
